beforeImage.name: Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities
beforeImage.description: Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities acquires and manages infrastructure ground leases in the United States. Its customers are infrastructure asset owners and operators that seek long-duration real-estate capital under transportation, utility, and communications sites rather than conventional corporate finance. The business model is long-duration and contract-based because value is tied to leased land interests and recurring rent streams. CBRE Investment Management reported in 2024 that the partnership had assembled a portfolio of more than 200 properties across 38 states since December 2022. Its principal operating footprint is in the United States. Accelerate and CBRE IM launched the partnership in 2022 to build a dedicated infrastructure ground-lease platform.

afterImage.name: Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities
afterImage.subsector: Infrastructure ground leases and site aggregation
afterImage.description: Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities, LLC (AIO) owns and manages land and ground leases beneath digital, renewable-energy and transportation/electrification infrastructure in the United States, including telecom, data-center, fiber, billboard, wind, solar, storage and EV-charging or logistics sites. The business was founded in 2016 and launched its dedicated CBRE Investment Management-backed infrastructure-site strategy in December 2022. Accelerate Investment Partners began operating as AIO on March 9, 2026 without a change to the platform, team or strategy. On May 7, 2026, AIO closed a $630 million primary raise that added Mubadala and Australian Retirement Trust capital and brought total equity commitments to approximately $1.26 billion. CBRE IM reported more than 450 sites across 47 states by July 2026. CBRE IM remains the sponsor and Mubadala is a current platform-equity co-investor; their exact percentages and complete legal vehicle mapping are not publicly disclosed. No later platform sale, exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.
